expected_value_creation: Typed, locked dependency graphs make hidden Skill supply-chain assumptions reviewable and route unresolved or propagated risk to governance.
beneficiary: Skill authors, evaluators, runtime operators, and organizations adopting portable QIF
supporting_evidence: Research over large Skill corpora recommends typed manifests, dependency-cluster management, risk warnings, and lockfile-like records.
success_criteria: Every declared component and dependency resolves by type, identity, evidence, and lock state.
Cycles, unresolved required dependencies, stale locks, direct risk, and transitive risk reproduce deterministically.
Identity and lineage remain explicitly distinct from safety, behavior, trust, and authority.
